title: Random-restriction bound on the decision-tree depth of a small circuit
statement:
Let $f\colon\{0,1\}^n \to \{0,1\}$ be a Boolean function on $n \ge 1$ variables, and let $d,s,w,l,t \in \bbn$ satisfy $d \ge 2$ and $s,w,l \ge 1$. Suppose $f$ is computed by some Boolean circuit of depth at most $d$, size at most $s$, and maximum fan-in at most $w$. Write $f\!\restriction_\rho$ for the restriction of $f$ by a restriction $\rho$, and let $D(g)$ denote the decision-tree depth of a Boolean function $g$, that is, the least depth of a decision tree computing it. Then, under a Bernoulli random restriction $\rho$ with parameter $\delta = \dfrac{1}{40w}\left(\dfrac{1}{40l}\right)^{d-2}$,
\[
  \bbP\bigl[\, D(f\!\restriction_\rho) > t \,\bigr]
  \;\le\; s\left(\tfrac{1}{2}\right)^{l} + \left(\tfrac{1}{2}\right)^{t}
    + s\,\exp\!\left(-\tfrac{n}{120w}\right) + s\,\exp\!\left(-\tfrac{n}{120l}\right).
\]
hypotheses_covered: f is a Boolean function on n variables
d, s, w, l, t are natural numbers
f is computed by a circuit of depth <= d, size <= s, and maximum fan-in <= w
replaced:
Replacing the coefficient $s-1$ by $s$ in the previous bound: under the same hypotheses and
the parameter $\mathrm{composedDelta}(w,l,d)$,
\[
  \Pr\!\left[\mathrm{dtDepth}(\mathrm{restrictFn}\,f\,\rho) > t\right]
  \le s(1/2)^{l} + (1/2)^{t} + s\,\exp\!\left(-\tfrac{n}{120w}\right)
    + s\,\exp\!\left(-\tfrac{n}{120l}\right).
\]
